integrity: Proof covers every positive conductance vector and every real input analytically; finite exact rational tests are supplementary, not an unrestricted proof. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite stars with one interior hub, strictly positive conductances, real signals, and complete-pair unweighted Gini variation only. An older 2008 source has year-level publication evidence but no authenticated day-level first-public date. Historical priority has an unindexed-equivalence risk.
title: Sharp complete-pair Gini norm of weighted star harmonic replacement
